description: Public media shared by the project website and this overview. A research overview, not a development log or evaluation dataset.
evidence_limit: Stills and the demo show a running prototype; they do not establish a complete experience, reliability or player benefit.

items.caption_en: A UE runtime still of the ward where a shift happens. It shows the setting, not evidence that complete tasks are playable.
items.caption_zh: 一班工作发生的病房，UE 实机静帧。呈现场景，不作为完整任务已经可玩的证据。

items.caption_en: Beds, curtains and the space beside them decide where people stand to talk.
items.caption_zh: 床位、床帘和床边的空间决定人站在哪里说话。

items.caption_en: One session's hospital floor; room names relabelled for public display.
items.caption_zh: 一局医院的楼层平面（英文标注）；房间名为公开说明而重新标注。

items.caption_en: One session's hospital floor (Chinese labels); room names relabelled for public display.
items.caption_zh: 一局医院的楼层平面；房间名为公开说明而重新标注。

items.caption_en: Mid-term demo, 1:21, 720p, no audio. Synthetic answer set and automated input; a development panel is blurred from about 32 s to 48 s.
items.caption_zh: 中期演示，1:21，720p，无声。合成答卷与自动操作；约 32–48 秒的开发面板已模糊。

items.caption_en: An in-game view from an offline development run: Dr Zhou and Lin Chuan in the handover office. Each card shows the name, the role and ‘No confirmed purpose yet’; the current task is at the top right. Synthetic answers, not human play.
items.caption_zh: 离线开发局的实机画面：周主任与林川在交班办公室。身份卡写着姓名、职务和“暂无已确认的行为目的”，右上角是本段任务。使用合成答卷，不是真人游玩。

items.caption_en: An in-game view from an offline development run: the patient Liu Lan in her own ward, with the talk prompt that appears when the crosshair is on her. Synthetic answers, not human play.
items.caption_zh: 离线开发局的实机画面：病人刘岚在自己的病房里，准星对准她时出现交谈提示。使用合成答卷，不是真人游玩。
